intent_en: To illustrate the significant decline in the average number of births per woman in Bangladesh from 1960 to 2019.
narration_support: In 1960, the average Bangladeshi woman had seven kids. In 1995, four, and in 2019, it was down to two.
chart_support: Area chart titled 'Births Per Woman' showing a downward trend from 1960 to 2019.
evidence_note: The narration explicitly mentions the demographic (Bangladeshi women) and the timeline (1960-2019) with a decreasing trend, which aligns with the chart's title 'Births Per Woman' and its visual downward slope over the same years.
